QUOTE: "if !approved && on_tool_call set → approved = true   ← !!" and "Deny is enforced only in `ServerManager::execute`, after approval."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says unmatched calls are denied when no callback is registered (default-deny) and only auto-approved via a callback quirk. It never concludes that a tool on neither list is not denied and runs.
